question: If the perimeter of one face of a cube is 48 cm, then its volume is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In a **cube**, all faces are **squares**.

**Side (a)** = **Perimeter** ÷ 4 = 48 ÷ 4 = 12 cm

**Volume** = (Side)³ = 12³

**Volume** = 1728 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 1728 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Perimeter** of one face = 48 cm

**Formula Used:**

**Perimeter** of a square face = 4 × a

**Volume** of a cube = a³

where **'a'** is the side of the **cube**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/684faf62b3125c5258419ebf9f2be8d7e44ba2f9006d04a15a65ff4fc4ee6a05.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 4 × a = 48

⇒ a = 48 ÷ 4

⇒ a = 12 cm

Now, calculate the **Volume**:

⇒ **Volume** = a × a × a

⇒ **Volume** = 12 × 12 × 12

⇒ **Volume** = 1728 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 1728 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of Cube

The total area of all six faces of the **cube** is given by the formula TSA = 6a².

Lateral Surface Area (LSA)

The area of the four vertical faces (excluding top and bottom) is LSA = 4a².

Diagonal of a Cube

The longest distance between two opposite corners of a **cube** is d = a√3.

Face Diagonal

The diagonal of a single square face of the **cube** is given by dfₐ꜀ₑ = a√2.</p
